extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from source-reviewed Table 2/Table 4, CD methods/results, helical wheel figure, antimicrobial Table 3, and discussion; no direct membrane-permeabilization or toxin-inhibition assay was performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectroscopy showed selected mastoparan analogs adopt α-helical structure in membrane-mimetic TFE and SDS environments, supporting an indirect membrane-interaction context rather than a direct lysis/permeabilization mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: MP, MP-RIP, RIP-MP, MP analogs, TP10 analogs measured in Table 4
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD in TFE/SDS is a membrane-mimetic structural assay, not direct bacterial membrane permeabilization evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors interpret higher antimicrobial activity of MP-RIP and RIP-MP as correlated with hydrophobicity and stabilization of α-helical structure in hydrophobic or anionic-micelle environments.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: MP-RIP, RIP-MP, MP-[Lys2,Ile4] RIP, [Lys2,Ile4] RIP-MP, TP10 analogs
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a correlation across physicochemical parameters, MIC values, and CD results; it should not be promoted to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The RIP-containing analog rationale includes literature-backed RNAIII-inhibiting peptide context for staphylococcal toxin synthesis/cell adhesion, but this paper did not directly assay RNAIII inhibition or toxin production.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Keep as rationale/context only; source-review found no direct toxin-inhibition assay in local XML/PDF/supplement.
